purpose: Test, on 54 new people recorded on two days, hypotheses carried over from the BCI IV 2a findings: electrode reduction by relevance, relevance against random, who gains from fewer electrodes, 8-bit arithmetic, the session-1 precision map, and day-to-day alignment.
claim_boundary: Prospective for Lee2019: conditions, hypotheses and tests were fixed in this plan before any Lee2019 session-2 trial was scored, but they were chosen knowing the BCI IV 2a test results they carry over. It concerns this dataset's 54 people and its two-class task, not the frozen 2a configuration, which it does not change. Bit widths below 8 are simulated; nothing is timed.

H1.claim: Dropping the least relevant electrodes does not hurt accuracy

H1b.claim: The same at 16 electrodes, the count deployed for BCI IV 2a

H2.claim: Relevance beats random electrodes of the same count
H2.contrast: relevance-16 minus random-16 (mean of its three lists), FP32

H3.claim: People decoded worse with all electrodes gain more from dropping the least relevant ones
H3.contrast: Spearman rho between full-62 accuracy on the session-2 offline run and relevance-45 minus full-62 on the online run (separate trials, so measurement noise cannot make the correlation)
H3.test: rho below 0, one-sided permutation p < 0.05 (10,000 permutations, seed 690)

H4.contrast: simulated 8/8 minus simulated float, for full-62, relevance-45 and relevance-16
H4.test: in each: interval lower bound above -0.5 pp and no participant losing more than 2 pp

H4b.claim: The precision map read from BCI IV 2a session 1 carries over to another dataset
H4b.contrast: the 2a map (pooled-0.5) minus 8/8, for full-62 and relevance-16
H4b.test: in both: interval lower bound above -2 pp

H5.contrast: full-62-ea with session 2 aligned on its offline run, minus full-62 unaligned, both scored on the online run

H5b.claim: The same with 45 and 16 electrodes, and with all session-2 trials aligned
H5b.contrast: relevance-45-ea and relevance-16-ea as H5; each -ea condition aligned with all of session 2 against its unaligned model on all trials

analysis: all session-2 trials; seeds averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690)
dataset: Lee et al. 2019 (OpenBMI) motor imagery via MOABB Lee2019_MI; mibci.lee2019 preprocessing
alignment: Euclidean alignment per recording day (He and Wu 2019), as scripts/alignment_study.py
